real_world_variants.subject: Terrace Party
real_world_variants.lyrics: Shake it up baby now, twist and shout!

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Diogo Jota
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics:
Oh he wears the number 20, he will take us to victory,
And when he's running down the left wing, he'll cut inside and score for LFC,
He's a lad from Portugal, better than Figo don't you know,
Oh his name is Diogo!

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Roberto Firmino
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.original_source_song: Y dale alegría a mi corazón
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics:
There's something that the Kop wants you to know,
The best in the world his name is Bobby Firmino,
Our number nine,
Give him the ball and he will score every time,
Si Señor, give the ball to Bobby and he will score!

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Mohamed Salah
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics:
Mo Salah! Mo Salah! Mo Salah! Running down the wing!
Salah la la la la la la la, Egyptian King!

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Thiago Alcântara
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics:
Thiago, Thiago Alcântara!
You dance through the midfield like nobody does,
The first time I saw you I knew it was love,
Thiago, Thiago Alcântara!

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.chant_name: I'm So Glad That Jürgen Is a Red
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Jürgen Klopp
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics:
I'm so glad that Jürgen is a Red,
I'm so glad he delivered what he said,
Jürgen said to me you know, we'll win the Premier League you know, he said so,
I'm in love with him and I feel fine!

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Luis Díaz
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics:
His name is Lucho, he's from Barrancas,
And he plays for Liverpool!
He scores with his left, he scores with his right,
And when he scores, he dances all night!

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Dominik Szoboszlai
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics:
Dominik Szoboszlai, Hungarian lad who can hit it so high,
Dancing past players like he doesn't care,
Dominik Szoboszlai!

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Federico Chiesa
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.original_artist: Dean Martin (Luis Demetrio / Pablo Beltrán Ruiz)
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics:
We can hear them crying in Turin, Federico he's here to win,
One chat with Arne Slot and he said ciao, I'm a Kopite now!

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.chant_name: Virgil van Dijk (He's Our Centre Half)
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Virgil van Dijk
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics:
He's our centre-half, he's our number four,
Watch him defend and we watch him score,
He can pass the ball, calm as you like,
He's Virgil van Dijk, he's Virgil van Dijk!

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Sadio Mané
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics: Sadio! (Mané!) / Running down the wing, / Hear the Kopites sing, / And we won it in Madrid!

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Divock Origi
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics: Saturday night and I like the way you move, Divock Origi! / Saturday night and I like the way you move, Divock Origi!

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Steven Gerrard
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.original_source_song: Que Sera, Sera (Whatever Will Be, Will Be)
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics:
Steve Gerrard, Gerrard,
He'll pass the ball 40 yards,
He's big and he's fucking hard,
Steve Gerrard, Gerrard!

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.chant_name: Fernando Torres (Armband Proved He Was a Red)
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Fernando Torres
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.original_artist: Patrick Gilmore / American Civil War March
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics:
His armband proved he was a red, Torres, Torres!
You'll Never Walk Alone it said, Torres, Torres!
We bought the lad from sunny Spain, he gets the ball and scores again,
Fernando Torres, Liverpool's number nine!

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Luis Suárez
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics: His name is Luis Suarez and he just can't get enough, / He just can't get enough!

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Alonso, Sissoko, Gerrard, Mascherano
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics:
We've got the best midfield in the world!
We've got Xabi Alonso, Momo Sissoko, Gerrard and Mascherano!

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Jamie Carragher
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics: We all dream of a team of Carraghers, a team of Carraghers, a team of Carraghers!

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Liverpool Identity & Championship Run
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.original_source_song: The Ballad of the Green Berets
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics:
Liverbird upon my chest, we are the men of Shankly's best,
A silver cup to crown the year, to make the Kopites shout and cheer!

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Anfield Heritage
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics: All round the Fields of Anfield Road, where once we watched the King Kenny play...

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Kopite Legend
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics: Oh I am a Liverpudlian, I come from the Spion Kop...

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: European Conquest
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics: We've conquered all of Europe, we're never gonna stop...

liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.subject: Club Anthem
liverpool_chant_encyclopedia.lyrics: When you walk through a storm, hold your head up high...
